categoryPaths: Our Trusted Partners > Exclusive Offers > membership
shortDesc:
What is Amazon Prime?

Amazon Prime is a paid subscription service by Amazon that provides exclusive benefits like free fast delivery, unlimited video and music streaming, early access to deals, and more. In India, it is especially valued for its affordable pricing and wide variety of features across shopping and entertainment.

Benefits of Amazon Prime in India

Amazon Prime combines savings, convenience, and entertainment into one powerful membership. It goes beyond just fast delivery by offering a complete digital experience for modern consumers.

What Does Amazon Prime Include?

  •  Free Fast Delivery: One-day and two-day delivery on millions of items.
  •  Unlimited Streaming: Access movies, shows, and Amazon Originals on Prime Video.
  •  Ad-Free Music: Over 100 million songs and podcasts via Amazon Music.
  •  Exclusive Deals: Early access to Prime Day, Big Deal Days, and Lightning Deals.
  •  Prime Reading: Borrow eBooks, comics, and more at no extra cost.
  •  Amazon Fresh & Pantry: Fast grocery delivery in select cities.

Why Choose Amazon Prime?

Whether you’re binge-watching your favorite web series, listening to ad-free music, or ordering daily essentials, Prime makes life easier and more rewarding. It’s perfect for families, students, and anyone who shops or streams regularly. As an Amazon Associate, I earn from qualifying purchases.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Where can I learn more about the various Prime benefits?

    To learn more about Prime benefits, visit www.amazon.in/primebenefits

  • What happens if I join a plan and later realize i want other benefits also and want to switch to another plan?

    You can seamlessly upgrade from 1. Prime Shopping edition to Prime or Prime Lite plans 2. Prime Lite to Prime plans anytime during your membership period. You need to visit https://www.amazon.in/prime to upgrade.

  • How do I cancel my plan?

    If you signed-up for your Prime membership directly through us, you may cancel your Prime membership at any time by visiting https://www.amazon.in/mc.

  • How many devices can be used simultaneously on a Prime subscription?

    You can access shopping benefits simultaneously without any restrictions. Under Prime Lite plan, you can access video benefits on only 1 device. Under Prime plan, you can access video benefit on upto 5 devices including 2 TVs. You can use music benefits on only 1 device simultaneously.

  • Can I turn off/on auto-renewal during the course of my membership?

    Yes, you can manage your auto-renewal selection and turn it on/off as per your choice during the course of your membership on ( https://www.amazon.in/mc ). If you have got your membership through a telecom partner or billed through Google - please contact the respective partner to make changes to your auto-renewal mandate.
